archive.contract: Parts have an entry/byte budget; one larger file occupies its own part and is never rejected or split. Each part hashes its source files before/after creation and verifies all archive payloads. Seal requires the full source metadata (device/inode/mode/size/mtime/ctime/link target) unchanged since plan, every part present, and every archive checksum unchanged. Access time is excluded. No evidence file is removed or rewritten.
